versions.summary: A git source-control panel with staging, rich diffs, and themed file icons.
notes: Stage, unstage, and discard files from a new Changes panel.
Click a change to open a rich unified or side-by-side diff.
Browse the worktree in an All Files tree; scrollbars now match the theme.

versions.summary: File tool calls now show as pin cards with hover-to-preview diffs.
notes: Read/Write/Edit calls render as compact file cards instead of raw paths.
Hover an edit card to preview its line-level diff.

versions.summary: First public build of Hyprlayer with in-app self-update.
notes: Native desktop app for spec-driven development.
Automatic, signed in-app updates on macOS and Windows.
